subject: Final offer adjustment needed — last-mile acceptance window
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate update — Ethan Cole (Sr. Infrastructure) — urgent approval request

Team,

Quick update on Ethan Cole (final-stage Sr. Infrastructure Engineer). He verbally prefers Redwood but just got a competing offer from NimbusCloud: $30k higher base and immediate signing bonus. They gave him a hard deadline to respond by Monday EOD PT (2026-09-20).

What I need from you today:
- Approve moving Ethan to the top of the comp band (Band 6C, high of band base) OR confirm an explicit sign-on amount we can offer (one-time).
- Confirm we can commit to the proposed start window (target 10/18) and flexible remote stipend ask (one-time $2k home-office).

Attachments: CV_Ethan_Cole.pdf, Offer_Ethan_Cole_20260914.pdf (draft), comp-band-snapshot.xlsx

Context: Hiring manager (Maya) recommended Ethan for infra infra-reqs and is willing to increase the base within band. Candidate has strong infra performance background (distributed systems, KVM/runtime optimizations) and is already cleared on references. Small risk: if we do nothing by Monday he will likely sign with Nimbus.

Proposed guardrails for approval:
- Base at high of Band 6C + $20k one-time sign-on (finance-estimated impact ~3 months of budget runway).
- Sign-on payable over first 2 payrolls.

Please reply with APPROVE / ADJUST / DENY and any numbers so I can finalize and send the written offer to him this afternoon.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Camila — thanks for the note and the materials. I agree he's worth prioritizing. My ask to comp: get him to top of Band 6C for base. If we can’t flex beyond band, offer a $20k sign-on and the $2k home-office stipend.

I can commit to the 10/18 start date. We need to move quickly because he is a fill-critical hire for the infra runtime project. If we can lock written terms by EOD Monday, I’ll push for expedited onboarding.

+1 to the proposed payment cadence.

Maya

If finance confirms the $22k sign-on and Maya commits to the start date, Camila please send the written offer with the updated numbers and a 7-day acceptance window (candidate requested Monday, but we can be explicit that this offer expires in 7 days).

Conditions:
- Sign-on capped at $22,000 payable via payroll split over the first two pay runs.
- Manager must confirm the 10/18 start date in writing (Maya, please reply-all with confirmation).
- Comp band adherence: we will set base at the top of Band 6C as requested.

Subject: Official offer — Redwood Inference (Sr. Infrastructure Engineer)

Ethan — great speaking earlier. Thank you for your patience while we finalized details. We’re excited to extend an offer for the Sr. Infrastructure Engineer role. Summary of the written offer (attached Offer_Ethan_Cole_20260914.pdf):

- Base salary: $215,000 (top of Band 6C)
- One-time sign-on: $22,000 (payable across first two payrolls)
- Home-office stipend: $2,000 (one-time)
- Target start date: October 18, 2026 (flexible)
- Standard equity grant and benefits as outlined in the attached offer

This offer is contingent on standard background check and reference checks. Please note this written offer expires on 2026-09-21 23:59 PT (7 days from issuance). If you need an earlier decision window to beat another offer, let me know and we will try to accommodate.

Attachments: Offer_Ethan_Cole_20260914.pdf, CV_Ethan_Cole.pdf

Next steps: Please review and reply with ACCEPT / COUNTER by 2026-09-21 EOD. If you have a specific request (e.g., different start date or sign-on cadence), include it in your reply and we’ll review immediately.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Thanks — I appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity. I’m very excited about Redwood and the infra work you described. The base and sign-on look competitive compared to the other offer. Two quick asks before I sign:

1) Can the sign-on be payable in full on first payroll instead of split? (This would help with timing for my relocation.)
2) Would you consider a small remote work equipment reimbursement (instead of the $2k stipend) so I can purchase a standing desk (I can provide receipts).

I can provide a signed acceptance by Thursday 9/16 EOD if these two items are confirmed in writing. Please let me know and I’ll sign the PDF.

Best,
